d: Patna Pirates defeated their arch-rivals Jaipur Pink Panthers by a 43-41 scoreline in match 41 of Pro Kabaddi League Season 11. Devank and Ayan's unstoppable raids added 24 raid points in the Pirates' score. Arjun Deshwal on the other hand, scored 20 raid points for Jaipur Pink Panthers and kept his team in the game. Tune into PKL Season 11 every day from 7:30 PM, only on the Star Sports Network and Disney+ hotstar. Catch all the LIVE updates on prokabaddi.com or the Pro Kabaddi Official App.
